memories.memory: My income from freelance exhibitions and commissioned murals varies widely, but last year I averaged about $3,200 a month before expenses.
I paid $780 each month for a small studio in Istanbul until I moved my workspace into a cheaper shared arts building in February 2025.
In 2024, I put roughly $6,000 of my savings into a friend's experimental gallery project, and the investment has not produced any return yet.
I still owe about $2,400 on a personal loan I took out to replace my large-format printer after it broke during an important commission.
I send my mother around $300 most months to help with household expenses, although I reduce the amount when freelance work is slow.
A regional arts foundation awarded me a $9,500 grant in June 2025, but nearly half of it went toward materials, venue hire, and local taxes.
I keep an emergency reserve of about $4,000, but I dipped into it recently to cover two months of rent when a client delayed a payment.
